0022600215.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-9) host the Orlando Magic (2-7) in the Kings' 11th game of the 2026-27 season. Sacramento is 0-5 at home, on a three-game losing streak, and sits 14th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 8 games back, while Orlando is 0-4 at home, on a four-game losing streak, and 12th in the East. Ben Simmons and Maxime Raynaud are out for the Kings, and Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, Paolo Banchero, and Tristan da Silva are out for the Magic; the teams have not met yet this season, and the Kings lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 121-117 in Orlando.
